newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada Prairie elevator space averages 24 percent.
newsitem.headline: Canada Prairie elevator space averages 24 percent.

text.p: Vacant space in primary elevators across Canada's Prairies averaged 24 percent, slightly less than 25 percent two weeks ago, the Canadian Wheat Board said in a statement.

Alberta elevators had the most space available at an average 35 percent, compared with 38 percent two weeks ago. Saskatchewan elevators averaged 21 percent versus 22 while Manitoba averaged 15 percent, the same level as two weeks ago.
Rail hopper car unloads between October 7 and 13 in Vancouver exceeded the target of 3,400 to 3,412 but fell short of the target for Prince Rupert of 1,500 at 857, the CWB said.
Thunder Bay unloads were 3,240, up from the 2,800 target and Churchill's unloads totalled 508 from 300.
